narrow_gap_0.headline: 14 planners tie at the top; run Thorough or more seeds to separate them (n=5 per planner, best 5/5 reached B, 95 % CI 57 %-100 %).
narrow_gap_0.more_seeds: What more seeds buy: Quick separates 5/5 from 0/5; telling 5/5 from 4/5 needs about 33 seeds (95 % Wilson: 5/5 57 %-100 %, 0/5 0 %-43 %). Every tied planner has the same success rate here (100 % of distinct runs), so more seeds only split them if some start failing; median time to B orders them meanwhile.
